devdoc.details: Manages user registration, roles, and blacklist status for an      Anti-Money Laundering (AML) demo system. Roles:  - REQUESTER: a user who can request funds  - FUNDER:    a user who can approve/send funds  - ADMIN:     privileged role able to blacklist/whitelist users NOTE: This contract is intended as an educational / prototype building block. A production AML system would additionally need off-chain risk scoring, KYC integration, and should never gate compliance decisions on income level alone.

constructor.details: Sets the deploying address as the contract admin.

returns._0: The UserRole of _user (UserRole.NONE if never registered).

params._user: Address whose payment count should be incremented.
Address whose request count should be incremented.

returns._0: True if the address has registered, false otherwise.

params._name: Display name of the user. Must not be empty.
params._role: Role to assign. Must not be UserRole.NONE.

params._fundRequestContract: Address of the deployed FundRequest contract.

params._paymentProcessorContract: Address of the deployed PaymentProcessor contract.

params._annualIncome: New stated annual income, in wei.
params._name: New display name. Must not be empty.

documentation.text:
@title UserRegistry
 @dev Manages user registration, roles, and blacklist status for an
      Anti-Money Laundering (AML) demo system.
 Roles:
  - REQUESTER: a user who can request funds
  - FUNDER:    a user who can approve/send funds
  - ADMIN:     privileged role able to blacklist/whitelist users
 NOTE: This contract is intended as an educational / prototype building
 block. A production AML system would additionally need off-chain risk
 scoring, KYC integration, and should never gate compliance decisions on
 income level alone.
@dev Role assigned to a registered user.
@dev Full profile of a registered user.
